# SHOGHMOUM (شغموم) — Brand Specification for AI & Developers

> One self-contained file. Give it to any AI assistant or developer and it has everything needed to produce on-brand work:
> meaning, voice, colours, type, logo rules (with the exact SVG source), pattern, measuring grid, highlight, layout and web adaptation.
> Version 2026-10-09. Company: **شغموم للمقاولات العامة** (Shoghmoum General Contracting), Madinah, Saudi Arabia.

## How to read this
- **[APPROVED]** = decided by the owner or present in the original identity file. Do not change.
- **[PROPOSED]** = web adaptation derived from approved rules; implement, then confirm with the owner before launch.
- **[OPEN]** = undecided; ask, do not assume.
- Governing rule: every new design must be better than the last; nothing approved is undone.
- Language: the website is Arabic-first, `dir="rtl" lang="ar"`. Keep all Arabic strings in this file verbatim.

---

## 1. Brand meaning & voice [APPROVED]

- **Meaning of the name:** الشغموم = النبيه الفطن — the alert, perceptive one who does not stop at executing what is written but sees what was *not* written: catches gaps before they become problems and proposes solutions that cut cost and improve the result. (Use this meaning, not the classical-lexicon one.)
- **Founding story:** even the most precise drawings cannot contain 100% of site reality. A residual ~10% — unforeseen problems or improvement opportunities the planners did not see — separates an ordinary project from an exceptional one. That is where Shoghmoum shows up. Positioning: *an extra eye for the owner, not merely an executor.*
- **Personality:** formal, trustworthy, innovative, contemporary (رسمية، موثوقة، مبتكرة، عصرية) — modern/global feel with a light local Madinah flavour. The output should feel like it comes from a high-end content studio/agency; in contracting this attracts the selective client.
- **Services in three words:** عظم · تشطيبات · إشراف (structure · finishes · supervision). Marketing focus: finishing quality.
- **Lines (verbatim):**
  - «عين على ما غاب عن الورق» — defines the name (most-used).
  - «شغموم وقت اللزوم يجملك» — closing line (most-used, Oct 2026). Earlier approved spelling: «شغموم عند اللزوم يجملك». **[OPEN] pick one for the site.**
  - «نبني الثقة قبل الجدران» — tagline, paired with the closing line.
  - «يوم التسليم كل التشطيبات متشابهة. بعد سنتين تفترق.» — positioning / bio core.
  - «التشطيب الزين ما يبان يوم التسليم — يبان بعد سنتين» — original form of the line above.
  - «وطن يُبنى» — **INTERNAL ONLY. Never publish.**
- **Name rule:** «شغموم» only (never «بن شغموم»). Latin: SHOGHMOUM. Never put a "company name — city" line at the top of a layout; the top is for the important message.
- **Voice rules:** talk like an expert contractor speaking politely to an owner on site — clear, Saudi dialect for social, clean modern Arabic for formal pages; explain a defect by its felt consequence, not a number; no absolute promises where reality is probabilistic; never "we are the best"; no clichés such as «تكلفة واضحة · التزام بالمدة · تنفيذ نظيف»; no AI-sounding phrasing (personified objects, suspense templates, manufactured paradoxes, office metaphors like رحلة / بوصلة / مفتاح); warranty is mentioned only as «ضد سوء التنفيذ»; don't publish detailed numeric specs for free; concise but never at the cost of completeness. When writing to large counterparties, never inflate the company's size — state the small scale plainly as an advantage.
- **Contact:** phone & WhatsApp `0553346250` (`+966553346250`), domain `shoghmoum.com`, Instagram/TikTok `@shoghmoum`. Registered member of the Saudi Contractors Authority.

## 2. Colour

### Palette
| Token | Hex | Arabic | Status | Use |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| maroon | `#441420` | العنابي | APPROVED primary | dark ground, text on light, logo & illustration ink |
| sand | `#E9EAD9` | الرملي | APPROVED secondary | light ground, text on maroon |
| terracotta | `#814B41` | الطوبي | APPROVED accent | LIGHT grounds only: eyebrows, series names, secondary emphasis |
| gold | `#AA8302` | الذهبي | APPROVED highlight | the ONE highlight per view: brush swipe, callout bar, dashed guides, labels on maroon. Always pure — never with opacity |
| gold-light | `#D6B44E` | الذهبي الفاتح | illustration-only | highlights inside engraved drawings; never text/UI |
| black | `#0E0E0E` | الأسود | limited | only as one of the 4 grounds of Instagram highlight covers |
| periwinkle | `#A7B5DC` | الأزرق البنفسجي | RESERVED | in palette, deliberately unused — not without approval |
| aqua | `#9CC7C9` | الأكوا | RESERVED | in palette, deliberately unused — not without approval |

- **Rejected:** `#E6E7E2` (export error on the source logo artboards). Always use `#E9EAD9`.
- **Illustration palette (original engraving colours, illustrations only):** ink `#0B0C0A`, tan `#BA8953`, tan-light `#D4AE7D`, cream `#FEEDC1`, red `#93412F`, red-light `#BE6748`.
- **Pairs:** maroon ground → sand text, sand accent, gold highlight. Sand ground → maroon text, terracotta accent, gold highlight (gold as shapes/bars only, never text — 2.89:1).
- Backgrounds are rendered at the exact hex: no vignettes, grain, gradients or overlays on brand grounds.

maroon 40–50% · sand 40–50% (together 85–90% of every screen) · terracotta ≤5% · gold ≤2–3% (one highlight per screen) · illustration colours only inside drawings · reserved colours 0%.

## 3. Typography
- **[APPROVED]** `IBM Plex Sans Arabic` for all new text (SIL OFL; woff2 + CSS included in `04_typography/fonts/`, or Google Fonts `family=IBM+Plex+Sans+Arabic:wght@400;500;600;700`). Weights: 400 body · 500 labels/secondary · 600 headings & callouts · 700 big numerals.
- **[APPROVED]** Rejected alternative: Noto Kufi Arabic + Readex Pro.
- The logo was drawn in **Greta Arabic** (commercial, Typotheque) and is outlined — never set new text in it.
- Numerals: Arabic-Indic (١٢٣) inside Arabic copy; Latin digits only in codes / tel links.
- **[PROPOSED]** Latin-only pages: IBM Plex Sans (sibling family).

### Approved social scale (px on a 1080-wide canvas)
eyebrow 36/600 (accent colour, tracking .04–.06em) · title 96/600, line-height 1.24, tracking −0.01em, exactly two lines · body 44/400, line-height 1.7, indented 78px from the title edge · callout «السكة» 40/500 with an 8px gold bar on its inline-start edge, must stand out more than body · margins 96px. Dense slides: title 72, body 34, callout 36/600.

### [PROPOSED] Web scale
eyebrow clamp(13px,1.1vw,16px)/600 · h1 clamp(38px,6vw,76px)/600 lh1.24 · h2 clamp(28px,3.6vw,48px)/600 lh1.3 · h3 clamp(20px,2vw,26px)/600 · body clamp(16px,1.15vw,19px)/400 lh1.8 · callout clamp(18px,1.4vw,22px)/600 lh1.6 · measure 55–70 Arabic characters.

## 4. Logo

| Mark | Ratio | Use | Files |
|---|---|---|---|
| lockup — «شغموم» over SHOGHMOUM | 2.613:1 | primary: desktop header, footer, print | `02_logo/svg/shoghmoum-lockup-*.svg` |
| Arabic wordmark | 3.812:1 | tight spaces, mobile header, carousel header row | `…wordmark-ar-*.svg` |
| Latin wordmark | 11.714:1 | Latin-only contexts | `…wordmark-en-*.svg` |
| icon — four-point star with an S | 1.046:1 | avatar, favicon, watermark | `…icon-*.svg` |

- Colour variants per mark: maroon, sand, black, white, currentColor. Approved pairings: **maroon on sand**, **sand on maroon**; maroon on gold & sand on black only in highlight covers; terracotta icon on maroon is decorative only (2.21:1); black/white only where brand colours are technically impossible.
- **[PROPOSED]** Clear space: lockup/wordmarks = height of the SHOGHMOUM line (~22% of lockup height) on all sides; icon = ½ icon height. Minimum width: lockup 140px, Arabic wordmark 96px, icon 24px (use the favicon files below that).
- **Never:** stretch, rotate, skew, outline, shadow, gradient, 3D, recolour outside the table, gold logo, re-typeset in a font, change the Arabic/Latin spacing, place over busy imagery/pattern/grid, raster logo on the web.

## 5. Pattern [APPROVED]
- Three motifs on one rectangular grid **493.9 × 373.0** units (ratio 1.324), one motif centred per cell: **star** (primary, from the icon), **slash 45°** (most dynamic), **dot** (calmest).
- Opacity: 7% as an all-over texture; ~9% for the large cropped icon watermark. Colour = the ink of the ground.
- Sequence: first view → big cropped icon watermark in a top corner (~9%); middle sections → light texture (7%); final/sign-off section → no pattern.
- Never under text, never as a separate decorative band/strip (tried and rejected), never at high opacity.

Tiles (paths in tile units):

## 6. Measuring grid — «شبكة القياس» [APPROVED]
The owner considers it one of the most beautiful elements of the identity: a faded draughtsman's grid that is strongest under the drawing it supports and fades out toward the edges — the ground a drawing stands on, not wallpaper.
- Step 30px on a 1080 canvas (~2.8% of width); every 5th line is major (150px). Stroke 1px minor / 1.5px major.
- Colour = ink of the ground (sand lines on maroon, maroon lines on sand).
- Opacity on maroon: minor 0.11, major 0.24. On sand: minor 0.075, major 0.17. In small circles (highlight covers): 0.17/0.38 dark, 0.13/0.30 light.
- Radial fade mask: 100% at centre → 70% at half radius → 0 at the edge.
- Never under text; never a uniform page texture.
- **[PROPOSED]** web step 24px mobile / 30px ≥1024px. Ready files: `05_graphics/measuring-grid/`; CSS class `.sh-measure-grid`.

---

## 7. Gold brush highlight [APPROVED]
- Irregular marker swipe in `#AA8302`, tapered ends, wavy non-parallel edges — never a rectangle or rounded pill.
- Once per view / per carousel.
- The subject stays outside the swipe; only the predicate is swiped: «شغموم» | «وقت اللزوم يجملك». A short standalone term may be swiped whole.
- Text on the swipe: maroon, large (4.36:1). Files `05_graphics/brush/brush-gold-1..3.svg`; CSS `.sh-brush`.

## 8. Dashed lines & arrows [APPROVED]
3px stroke, dash 14 / gap 12, opacity 0.6–0.85; gold on maroon, maroon or gold on sand. Uses: ground line under a drawing, guide lines that tie a drawing to the layout (hugging the object, "as if the line were the wall"), simple dashed arrows pointing at an object. The half-ellipse cradle arc under a word is reserved for «عليك» / «عليه» (it represents a scale). Heavy solid corner brackets were rejected.

## 9. Layout [APPROVED unless marked]
- Rhythm **edge · indent · edge**: heading flush to the column edge; divider rule (104×5 on 1080, text colour at 85%) and body indented (~8–9% of the column); callout back to the edge.
- Text blocks optically centred, never pinned to the bottom edge.
- Locked grid for repeated items: headings start at the same height and size every time; only the end of the body varies.
- Grounds alternate maroon / sand; two consecutive blocks on the same ground is an error.
- Geometric balance: text beside a drawing goes where the shape narrows; distances are measured, not eyeballed. Generous empty space; elements with different roles never share a size.
- Things that are counted are drawn (cards, diagrams), never plain text lists.
- Everything vector; nothing blurs when zoomed.
- **[PROPOSED]** corner radius 2px (architectural); buttons = solid in text colour + ghost variant; build with logical properties (inline-start/end) for RTL.

## 10. Illustration & photography
- **[APPROVED]** Vintage woodcut-engraving style (hand-cut lines, hatching). The owner generates single objects on an empty ground, then they are separated and vectorised. Two approved colourings: brand (maroon ink, gold body, gold-light highlights) or the original engraving palette. A drawing shows the idea or the inspection method, not a tool alone. Rejected: cartoonish, code-drawn, crowded scenes. Reference images are inspiration only — never pasted.
- **[OPEN]** No photography guideline and no project photos yet. Proposal: real Shoghmoum site photos only, natural light, no colour filters, never under text.

## 11. Website application [PROPOSED]
| Block | Ground | Treatment |
|---|---|---|
| Header | maroon | Arabic wordmark on mobile, lockup on desktop; no "company — city" line |
| Hero | maroon | large cropped icon watermark in a top corner at 9%; two-line headline; at most one gold element |
| About / meaning | sand | the "10% that wasn't on the drawings" story; an engraving on the measuring grid |
| Services | maroon | عظم · تشطيبات · إشراف as cards on a locked grid; star texture 7% |
| Method | sand | a drawn path/diagram, not a list |
| Plastering spec form | — | existing mobile-first, view-only page («استمارة اللياسة») to be linked under the new domain |
| Projects | alternating | when photos exist |
| Closing / footer | opposite of previous | exactly three elements: «نبني الثقة قبل الجدران», «شغموم وقت اللزوم يجملك» (brush on the predicate), and the logo; no pattern |

Web assets: `06_web-assets/favicon/` (svg, ico, 16/32/48, apple-touch 180, 192, 512, maskable 512, `site.webmanifest`), `06_web-assets/social/og-image-1200x630.png`, `<meta name="theme-color" content="#441420">`.

## 12. Open decisions
1. «عند» vs «وقت» in the closing line. 2. Periwinkle/aqua on the site? 3. Photography + project photos. 4. A horizontal logo lockup (the file has only the stacked one). 5. Clear space, minimum sizes, web type scale and colour ratios above are proposals awaiting approval.
